pageSub: Send events from this workspace to your own systems. Each delivery is signed so your receiver can check it came from us. Personal data is left out unless you opt in.
loadErrorBody: The endpoint list could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
deniedBody: Webhooks need the webhooks.manage permission. Your role ({role}) does not have it. Ask a workspace owner.
deniedSupport: Webhook settings are not available inside a support session.
policyOffTitle: Webhooks are turned off for this organisation
policyOffBody: A platform administrator disabled outbound webhooks for your organisation. Existing endpoints stay listed but cannot be created or changed.
demoBody: These endpoints are samples. Nothing is saved and no request leaves this page. The test ping is simulated.
emptyBody: Add an https URL and pick the events to send. We sign every request with a secret that is shown once.
formUrlHelp: Must be a public https address. Private, local and cloud metadata addresses are refused.
formDescriptionHelp: Optional. Shown in this list only.
formEventsHelp: Pick the event types this endpoint receives.
formPiiHelp: Adds names, emails and phone numbers to the payload. Needs the pii.read permission, and is checked again on every delivery.
formFiltersHelp: Optional. Each filter keeps events whose field equals one of the values (comma separated).
formPickOne: Pick at least one event type.
secretBody: Copy this secret now. It is shown once and cannot be read again. Use it to verify the webhook-signature header on each request.
secretRotatedBody: Copy the new secret now. Both secrets sign requests for 24 hours, until {when}, so you can switch your receiver without losing events.
confirmDeleteBody: The endpoint, its secret and its delivery log are removed. Queued deliveries are dropped.
confirmRotateBody: A new secret is created. The old one keeps signing for 24 hours alongside it.
confirmPauseBody: No events are sent while it is paused. Events that happen in the meantime are not queued.
testSimulated: Simulated test ping succeeded. No request was sent.
why_dns: the host name did not resolve
why_redirect: the receiver answered with a redirect, which is not followed
limitReached: This workspace already has the maximum of 20 endpoints.
urlHttps: The URL must start with https://.
urlCredentials: The URL must not contain a user name or password.
urlBlocked: That address is not allowed. Use a public https address.
unknown_event_type: One of the event types is not recognised.
filterBadField: A filter field can use lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
filterBadValue: A filter value is empty or contains characters that are not allowed.
policyOff: Webhooks are turned off for your organisation.
piiNotAllowed: You need the pii.read permission to include personal fields.
logSub: Newest first. Response text is shortened and scrubbed. Entries are kept for 30 days.
logEmptyBody: Deliveries appear here after an event matches this endpoint, or after you send a test event.
logErrorBody: The delivery log could not be loaded.
replayOwnerOnly: Only a workspace owner can replay a delivery.
replayBody: The same event is sent again with the same webhook-id. The action is recorded in the audit log.
replay_event_gone: The original event is past retention and cannot be replayed.
replay_test_event: Test events cannot be replayed. Send a new test instead.
ownerOnly: Only a workspace owner can do this.
